'''Plaguehorn''' was a massive [[Reek/Legends|reek]] that was infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] during a [[Rakghoul pandemic|resurgence]] of the plague on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It lived in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] until it was [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Plaguehorn is a World Boss who only appears during the Rakghoul Resurgence on the planet Tatooine, a recurring World Event in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' that cycles between Tatooine, [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The reek was first introduced in the expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Update 2.5.<ref name="TOR" />
